**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 18.1–18.2 (¶ p0072–p0073) place all insurance obligations on Copperleaf (Vendor) and meet our preferred position in full:

| Coverage | Playbook preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| CGL | USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ same |
| Professional (E&O) | USD 2M | ✅ USD 2M |
| Cyber/privacy | USD 5M | ✅ USD 5M |
| Workers' comp | as required by law | ✅ plus employer's liability USD 1M |
| Certificates | on request | ✅ on request, plus cancellation notice |

Duration (term plus one year) also matches the model language, and § 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — both favourable to us.
